svg.title: z-fasta performance summary on real FASTA data
svg.desc: Benchmark comparison of z-fasta indexing, sequence extraction, and statistics against established FASTA tools on genome, transcriptome, and proteome datasets.

text.tspan: Right of 1x means z-fasta is faster
Right of 1x means z-fasta uses less memory
INDEX: .fai construction | GET: 1,000 BED rows x 1 kbp | STATS: complete report

tspan.tspan: Rust based (noodles, rust-bio), used wrappers and custom stats to showcase performace for comparison
SeqKit and seqtk stats are partial ecosystem references since they don't provide full report.

text.tspan: One baseline, three modules, three biological data shapes, and established FASTA peers.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
